60:             <p class="library-teaser">On the quietest street in the old quarter, two friends carry a lantern to every doorstep that has gone dark — and discover that light, shared, is the one treat that multiplies.</p>
61:             <blockquote class="library-quote">“No lights means no treats. Then we bring the Halloween to them.”</blockquote>

65:             </div>

74:           </div>
75:           <div class="library-body">
76:             <div class="library-tags"><span>Dream tale</span><span>3 scenes</span><span>~4 min</span></div>
77:             <h2>The Dream Beyond the Shadows</h2>
78:             <p class="library-teaser">For three nights Hexa Baby has not slept. Two guardians step through a star portal into a hallway that will not hold still, and tell the dark a better story.</p>
79:             <blockquote class="library-quote">“The nightmare did not disappear — it just became a hallway, and hallways have ends.”</blockquote>

95:             <h2>The Last Wandering Ghost</h2>
96:             <p class="library-teaser">A ghost has wandered Bell Street for a hundred years. Two friends sit down on the bakery steps and ask him, politely, how the whole thing ends.</p>
97:             <blockquote class="library-quote">“You don't look dangerous.” — “I've forgotten how.”</blockquote>
